body: Task M1.5 (branch sbx/m1.5-compat-run). Acceptance criteria (from docs/work-plan.md): Compatibility check — run the workshop factory on acp instead of handoff with no behavior change. Context from human: the acp-backed handoff shim is already merged (PRs #1, #3; see agent-comms/). The done check is a real run: exercise the workshop factory flow end to end with the shim in place of the reference handoff, compare behavior against the reference, and record the evidence. Tick M1.5 in the work plan only if the run really passes; otherwise leave it unticked with a note on what failed. Report back with a commit SHA and real test exit codes when done.
